chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Al-Nawfali, from Al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'The two hollows by which most of my community will enter the Fire are the belly and the private part.'

key_terms.الْأَجْوَفَانِ: The two hollows (referring to the stomach and genitals)

ai.seo_question: What are the two main reasons most people enter Hellfire according to this hadith?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, Shaykh al-Kulayni records this concise prophetic saying where 'al-ajwafan' (the two hollows) metaphorically identifies the stomach and the private parts as the primary gates to Hellfire due to unchecked desire. This hadith is central to Shia ethical discourse on *zuhd* (asceticism) and self-discipline, emphasizing that mastery over these two faculties is essential for spiritual purity and moral integrity.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Most of what my community would be consumed by the Fire are the two hollow (things) – the belly and the private part’.
en.sarwar: 5. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from al-Nawfali from al-Sakuni from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “

The Messenger of Allah has said, ‘Of my followers who go to hell, in the case of most of them it will so happen because of two hollow things: the stomach and the genital organs (for consuming unlawful things or committing sins)
